member.name: M:ktsu.Essentials.FileSystemProviders.Native.ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddNativeFileSystemProvider(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection)
member.summary: Registers the native filesystem provider.
member.remarks: The provider is registered as a singleton, both as its concrete type and as an additional in the resolvable set, so it can be resolved either way. The container constructs and owns each registration, which means disposable providers are disposed with it. Calling this more than once is a no-op.
member.param: The service collection to add the provider to.
member.returns: The same service collection, to allow chaining.
